description: A laboratory result report or diagnostic imaging report (X-ray, MRI, echocardiogram, ECG, stress test).

patient_date_of_birth.instruction: The patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

report_type.instruction: The type of test or study, e.g. lumbar X-ray, echocardiogram, CBC

procedure_code.instruction: CPT code of the study if written

service_date.instruction: The date the test or study was performed in YYYY-MM-DD format

performing_facility.instruction: The performing lab or facility name
